property.description: This enables checking of function parameters. When this is disabled, parameter checking code is not present and the footprint is reduced
This enables logging and the compilation of debug code. When disabled, logging and debug code is not present and the footprint is reduced.
This enables verbose logging. Verbose logging will only work if a EWF Log Function is set and logging is enabled.
Function the library uses for standard log messages when logging is enabled.
Function the library uses for error log messages when logging is enabled.

config.content:
#ifdef __cplusplus extern "C" { #endif
#include "bsp_api.h"
${config.azure.ewf.parameter_checking} ${config.azure.ewf.verbose_logging}
#if (1 == ${interface.azure.ewf.platform.threadx}) #define EWF_PLATFORM_THREADX #else #define EWF_PLATFORM_BARE_METAL #define EWF_PLATFORM_BUSY_WAIT(count) R_BSP_SoftwareDelay(count, BSP_DELAY_UNITS_MILLISECONDS) #endif
#if ${config.azure.ewf.debug} #define EWF_DEBUG
#ifndef EWF_LOG #define EWF_LOG(...) ${config.azure.ewf.log_function} #endif
#ifndef EWF_LOG_ERROR #define EWF_LOG_ERROR(...) ${config.azure.ewf.error_log_function} #endif
#else #define EWF_LOG(...) #define EWF_LOG_ERROR(...) #endif
#ifndef NX_DRIVER_IP_MTU #define NX_DRIVER_IP_MTU (1460) #endif
#ifdef __cplusplus } #endif
